Builds ready-to-use HTML (current condit: Builds ready-to-use HTML (current conditions with a wind rose) into html.current, for use in a VIS/Jarvis HTML widget.
Cloud cover and the current weather icon: Cloud cover and the current weather icon are estimated from a solar radiation sensor (if present), using this ioBroker installation's location (Admin -> System settings). Without a configured location or a solar sensor, a rougher estimate based on dew point (and pressure trend, if a barometer is present) is used instead. If neither is possible, no cloud cover or weather icon value is created.
Discovery failed, see the adapter log fo: Discovery failed, see the adapter log for details.
Duration requested per activation; will: Duration requested per activation; will be renewed automatically. Max 86400
Local IP address of the WeatherLink Live: Local IP address of the WeatherLink Live 6100 device, e.g. 192.168.1.50
Minimum 10 seconds as required by the We: Minimum 10 seconds as required by the WeatherLink Live 6100 Local API
No WeatherLink Live 6100 found on the lo: No WeatherLink Live 6100 found on the local network. Make sure the device and this ioBroker host are on the same network and multicast is not blocked, then enter the IP address manually.
Only needed if your VIS/Jarvis widget ho: Only needed if your VIS/Jarvis widget host does not resolve relative /adapter/davis/... image paths correctly - set this to your ioBroker web instance's own base URL, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8082
Requests the WeatherLink Live 6100 to br: Requests the WeatherLink Live 6100 to broadcast wind and rain data every 2.5s over UDP
Searches the local network for a Weather: Searches the local network for a WeatherLink Live 6100 via mDNS/Bonjour and fills in its IP address and port automatically
The WeatherLink Live 6100 always reports: The WeatherLink Live 6100 always reports values in imperial units; select "Metric" to convert temperature (°C), wind speed (km/h) and pressure (hPa) before storing them
